summary: Lloyds Banking Group plc filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in own shares, disclosing the purchase of 20,010,388 ordinary shares on 8 May 2026. Shares were bought from Goldman Sachs International at an average price of 99.3486 pence per share, within a range of 97.5 to 100.08 pence. The purchases are part of the company's existing share buyback programme announced on 30 January 2026; shares will be cancelled. This represents an open-market share repurchase, not a fixed-price tender. Investors should monitor ongoing buyback execution pace and any potential accretion to earnings per share.
